title: Completed response
description: A normal completed response establishes the baseline.

title: 401 · Invalid API key
description: A key rejected by the service is a configuration issue, not a retry problem.

title: 403 · Access denied
description: Inspect access and region evidence rather than guessing the cause from the status alone.

error.message: Access from this region is not supported.

title: 404 · Model or access mismatch
description: A model identifier may be incorrect or unavailable to the requesting project.

error.message: The requested fixture model is not available to this project.

title: 400 · Invalid request parameter
description: Correct the invalid field before making another request.

title: 429 · Rate limit, then recovery
description: A temporary rate limit supplies Retry-After. The simulated clock advances before one successful retry.

title: 429 · Credits exhausted
description: The same HTTP status has a different recovery path: replenishing credits or resolving billing. Retry-After does not override the error code.

title: 429 · Project spending limit
description: Project-level spending policy requires an account-owner action, not a retry loop.

title: 429 · Delay exceeds time budget
description: A 120-second server delay exceeds this tool's 30-second budget. The request is deferred instead of retried early.

title: 503 · Server overload, then recovery
description: A temporary server overload is followed by a completed response after bounded backoff.

title: 500 · Attempt limit reached
description: Three failed attempts stop the recovery loop and produce a handover.

title: Timeout · Outcome unknown
description: A timeout does not prove the POST was rejected. The tool avoids automatic replay and records the client request ID.

title: Connection failure · Investigate
description: A generic connection failure is insufficient evidence to diagnose DNS, a firewall, or a service outage.

title: 200 · Incomplete generation
description: HTTP 200 is not enough to close the incident when the response state is incomplete.

title: 200 · Non-JSON response
description: A proxy or intermediary may return HTML. The tool flags a protocol issue without logging the raw body.
